mapper.select: select di.*,m.name MName,m.model MModel,m.unit MaterialUnit,m.color MColor,m.standard MStandard,m.mfrs MMfrs,m.weight, m.position, m.img_name, m.other_field1 MOtherField1,m.other_field2 MOtherField2,m.other_field3 MOtherField3,m.enable_serial_number, m.enable_batch_number, m.brand, dp1.name DepotName,dp2.name AnotherDepotName, me.bar_code barCode, me.purchase_decimal from jsh_depot_item di left join jsh_material m on di.material_id=m.id and ifnull(m.delete_flag,'0') !='1' left join jsh_material_extend me on me.id=di.material_extend_id and ifnull(me.delete_Flag,'0') !='1' left join jsh_depot dp1 on di.depot_id=dp1.id and ifnull(dp1.delete_Flag,'0') !='1' left join jsh_depot dp2 on di.another_depot_id=dp2.id and ifnull(dp2.delete_Flag,'0') !='1' where di.header_id = #{headerId} and ifnull(di.delete_flag,'0') !='1' order by di.id asc

select di.* from jsh_depot_head dh left join jsh_depot_item di on dh.id=di.header_id and ifnull(di.delete_flag,'0') !='1' where 1=1 and ifnull(dh.delete_flag,'0') !='1' and di.material_extend_id = #{materialExtendId} and di.batch_number = #{batchNumber} and dh.type = '入库'

select m.id, m.name, m.standard, m.model, me.id meId,me.commodity_unit commodityUnit, me.purchase_decimal purchaseDecimal, me.wholesale_decimal wholesaleDecimal, me.bar_code mBarCode, me.sku from jsh_material m left join jsh_material_extend me on m.id=me.material_id and ifnull(me.delete_Flag,'0') !='1' where 1=1
and me.bar_code in (${barCodes})
and ifnull(m.delete_flag,'0') !='1' order by CASE WHEN me.bar_code LIKE 'W%' THEN 1 WHEN me.bar_code LIKE 'B%' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, m.id ASC

select m.id as materialId, m.name as materialName, me.bar_code as barCode, -- 当前库存作为本期结存 ifnull(( select sum(ifnull(current_number,0)) from jsh_material_current_stock mcs where mcs.material_id = m.id and ifnull(mcs.delete_flag,'0') !='1' ), 0) as currentPeriodStock,
-- 上期结存：根据库存平衡公式计算 -- 公式：上期结存 = 本期结存 - 本期入库 + 本期出库 -- 注意：这里使用GREATEST确保不会出现负数 GREATEST(0, ifnull(( select sum(ifnull(current_number,0)) from jsh_material_current_stock mcs where mcs.material_id = m.id and ifnull(mcs.delete_flag,'0') !='1' ), 0) - ifnull(( select sum(ifnull(di.basic_number,0)) from jsh_depot_item di left join jsh_depot_head dh on dh.id = di.header_id where di.material_id = m.id and dh.type = '入库' and ifnull(di.delete_flag,'0') !='1' and ifnull(dh.delete_flag,'0') !='1'
and dh.shop_name in
#{shopName}
and ( -- 本期时间范围：根据当前月份动态判断 (month(now()) >= 2 and month(now()) <= 7 and dh.oper_time >= concat(year(now()), '-02-01 00:00:00') and dh.oper_time <= concat(year(now()), '-07-31 23:59:59')) or (month(now()) >= 8 and dh.oper_time >= concat(year(now()), '-08-01 00:00:00') and dh.oper_time <= concat(year(now()) + 1, '-01-31 23:59:59')) or (month(now()) = 1 and dh.oper_time >= concat(year(now()) - 1, '-08-01 00:00:00') and dh.oper_time <= concat(year(now()), '-01-31 23:59:59')) ) ), 0) + ifnull(( select sum(ifnull(di.basic_number,0)) from jsh_depot_item di left join jsh_depot_head dh on dh.id = di.header_id where di.material_id = m.id and dh.type = '出库' and ifnull(di.delete_flag,'0') !='1' and ifnull(dh.delete_flag,'0') !='1'
and dh.shop_name in
#{shopName}
and ( -- 本期时间范围：根据当前月份动态判断 (month(now()) >= 2 and month(now()) <= 7 and dh.oper_time >= concat(year(now()), '-02-01 00:00:00') and dh.oper_time <= concat(year(now()), '-07-31 23:59:59')) or (month(now()) >= 8 and dh.oper_time >= concat(year(now()), '-08-01 00:00:00') and dh.oper_time <= concat(year(now()) + 1, '-01-31 23:59:59')) or (month(now()) = 1 and dh.oper_time >= concat(year(now()) - 1, '-08-01 00:00:00') and dh.oper_time <= concat(year(now()), '-01-31 23:59:59')) ) ), 0) ) as previousPeriodStock,
-- 本期出库：根据当前月份判断本期时间范围 ifnull(( select sum(ifnull(di.basic_number,0)) from jsh_depot_item di left join jsh_depot_head dh on dh.id = di.header_id where di.material_id = m.id and dh.type = '出库' and ifnull(di.delete_flag,'0') !='1' and ifnull(dh.delete_flag,'0') !='1'
and dh.shop_name in
#{shopName}
and ( -- 本期时间范围：根据当前月份动态判断 (month(now()) >= 2 and month(now()) <= 7 and dh.oper_time >= concat(year(now()), '-02-01 00:00:00') and dh.oper_time <= concat(year(now()), '-07-31 23:59:59')) or (month(now()) >= 8 and dh.oper_time >= concat(year(now()), '-08-01 00:00:00') and dh.oper_time <= concat(year(now()) + 1, '-01-31 23:59:59')) or (month(now()) = 1 and dh.oper_time >= concat(year(now()) - 1, '-08-01 00:00:00') and dh.oper_time <= concat(year(now()), '-01-31 23:59:59')) ) ), 0) as currentPeriodOut,
-- 上期出库：根据当前月份判断上期时间范围 ifnull(( select sum(ifnull(di.basic_number,0)) from jsh_depot_item di left join jsh_depot_head dh on dh.id = di.header_id where di.material_id = m.id and dh.type = '出库' and ifnull(di.delete_flag,'0') !='1' and ifnull(dh.delete_flag,'0') !='1'
and dh.shop_name in
#{shopName}
and ( -- 上期时间范围：根据当前月份判断 (month(now()) >= 2 and month(now()) <= 7 and dh.oper_time >= concat(year(now()) - 1, '-08-01 00:00:00') and dh.oper_time <= concat(year(now()), '-01-31 23:59:59')) or (month(now()) >= 8 and dh.oper_time >= concat(year(now()), '-02-01 00:00:00') and dh.oper_time <= concat(year(now()), '-07-31 23:59:59')) or (month(now()) = 1 and dh.oper_time >= concat(year(now()) - 1, '-02-01 00:00:00') and dh.oper_time <= concat(year(now()) - 1, '-07-31 23:59:59')) ) ), 0) as previousPeriodOut,
-- 本期入库：根据当前月份判断本期时间范围 ifnull(( select sum(ifnull(di.basic_number,0)) from jsh_depot_item di left join jsh_depot_head dh on dh.id = di.header_id where di.material_id = m.id and dh.type = '入库' and ifnull(di.delete_flag,'0') !='1' and ifnull(dh.delete_flag,'0') !='1'
and dh.shop_name in
#{shopName}
and ( -- 本期时间范围：根据当前月份动态判断 (month(now()) >= 2 and month(now()) <= 7 and dh.oper_time >= concat(year(now()), '-02-01 00:00:00') and dh.oper_time <= concat(year(now()), '-07-31 23:59:59')) or (month(now()) >= 8 and dh.oper_time >= concat(year(now()), '-08-01 00:00:00') and dh.oper_time <= concat(year(now()) + 1, '-01-31 23:59:59')) or (month(now()) = 1 and dh.oper_time >= concat(year(now()) - 1, '-08-01 00:00:00') and dh.oper_time <= concat(year(now()), '-01-31 23:59:59')) ) ), 0) as currentPeriodIn
from jsh_material m left join jsh_material_extend me on me.material_id = m.id and ifnull(me.delete_flag,'0') !='1' where 1=1 and ifnull(m.delete_flag,'0') !='1' and me.default_flag = 1
and (me.bar_code like #{bindKey} or m.name like #{bindKey} or m.mnemonic like #{bindKey} or m.standard like #{bindKey} or m.model like #{bindKey} or m.color like #{bindKey} or m.mfrs like #{bindKey} or m.brand like #{bindKey} or m.other_field1 like #{bindKey} or m.other_field2 like #{bindKey} or m.other_field3 like #{bindKey})
order by CASE WHEN me.bar_code LIKE 'W%' THEN 1 WHEN me.bar_code LIKE 'B%' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, m.id ASC limit #{offset}, #{rows}

select count(1) from jsh_material m left join jsh_material_extend me on me.material_id = m.id and ifnull(me.delete_flag,'0') !='1' where 1=1 and ifnull(m.delete_flag,'0') !='1' and me.default_flag = 1
and (me.bar_code like #{bindKey} or m.name like #{bindKey} or m.mnemonic like #{bindKey} or m.standard like #{bindKey} or m.model like #{bindKey} or m.color like #{bindKey} or m.mfrs like #{bindKey} or m.brand like #{bindKey} or m.other_field1 like #{bindKey} or m.other_field2 like #{bindKey} or m.other_field3 like #{bindKey})

select COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(mcs_sum.current_stock, 0) * COALESCE(me.commodity_decimal, 0)), 2), 0) as totalStockValue from jsh_material m -- 实时库存聚合（按物料） left join ( select material_id, sum(ifnull(current_number,0)) as current_stock from jsh_material_current_stock where ifnull(delete_flag,'0') != '1' and tenant_id = #{tenantId} group by material_id ) mcs_sum on mcs_sum.material_id = m.id -- 默认零售价 left join jsh_material_extend me on me.material_id = m.id and ifnull(me.delete_flag,'0') != '1' and me.default_flag = '1' and me.tenant_id = #{tenantId} where ifnull(m.delete_flag,'0') != '1' and m.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM( (COALESCE(current_stock.stock, 0) - COALESCE(future_impact.total_impact, 0) + COALESCE(exclude_shop.exclude_shop_out, 0)) * COALESCE(me.commodity_decimal, 0) ), 2), 0) as totalStockValue FROM jsh_material m -- 当前库存（按商品汇总） LEFT JOIN ( SELECT material_id, SUM(ifnull(current_number, 0)) as stock FROM jsh_material_current_stock WHERE ifnull(delete_flag, '0') != '1' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY material_id ) current_stock ON m.id = current_stock.material_id -- 指定日期及之后的所有单据影响（入库-出库），按商品汇总 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT di.material_id, SUM(CASE WHEN dh.type = '入库' THEN ifnull(di.basic_number, 0) WHEN dh.type = '出库' THEN -ifnull(di.basic_number, 0) ELSE 0 END) as total_impact FROM jsh_depot_head dh INNER JOIN jsh_depot_item di ON dh.id = di.header_id WHERE dh.status = '1' AND ifnull(dh.delete_flag, '0') != '1' AND ifnull(di.delete_flag, '0') != '1' AND DATE(dh.oper_time) >= DATE(#{targetDate}) AND dh.tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY di.material_id ) future_impact ON m.id = future_impact.material_id -- 指定日期当天指定店铺的销售出库数量（需要加回） LEFT JOIN ( SELECT di.material_id, SUM(ifnull(di.basic_number, 0)) as exclude_shop_out FROM jsh_depot_head dh INNER JOIN jsh_depot_item di ON dh.id = di.header_id WHERE dh.status = '1' AND ifnull(dh.delete_flag, '0') != '1' AND ifnull(di.delete_flag, '0') != '1' AND DATE(dh.oper_time) = DATE(#{targetDate}) AND dh.type = '出库' AND dh.sub_type = '销售' AND dh.shop_name = #{excludeShopName} AND dh.tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY di.material_id ) exclude_shop ON m.id = exclude_shop.material_id -- 默认零售价 LEFT JOIN jsh_material_extend me ON m.id = me.material_id AND ifnull(me.delete_flag, '0') != '1' AND me.default_flag = '1' AND me.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE ifnull(m.delete_flag, '0') != '1' AND m.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT m.id as materialId, COALESCE(mcs_sum.current_stock, 0) as currentStock, me.commodity_decimal as commodityDecimal, me.bar_code as barCode FROM jsh_material m -- 实时库存聚合（按物料）- 复用getTotalStockValueByTenant的逻辑 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT material_id, SUM(ifnull(current_number, 0)) as current_stock FROM jsh_material_current_stock WHERE ifnull(delete_flag, '0') != '1' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY material_id ) mcs_sum ON mcs_sum.material_id = m.id -- 默认零售价 - 复用getTotalStockValueByTenant的逻辑 LEFT JOIN jsh_material_extend me ON m.id = me.material_id AND ifnull(me.delete_flag, '0') != '1' AND me.default_flag = '1' AND me.tenant_id = #{tenantId} WHERE ifnull(m.delete_flag, '0') != '1' AND m.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT di.material_id as materialId, IFNULL(dh.shop_name, '') as shopName, DATE(dh.oper_time) as billDate, dh.type as billType, dh.sub_type as subType, SUM(CASE WHEN dh.type = '入库' THEN ifnull(di.basic_number, 0) ELSE 0 END) as inQuantity, SUM(CASE WHEN dh.type = '出库' THEN ifnull(di.basic_number, 0) ELSE 0 END) as outQuantity, SUM(CASE WHEN dh.type = '入库' THEN ifnull(di.basic_number, 0) WHEN dh.type = '出库' THEN -ifnull(di.basic_number, 0) ELSE 0 END) as totalImpact FROM jsh_depot_head dh INNER JOIN jsh_depot_item di ON dh.id = di.header_id WHERE dh.status = '1' AND ifnull(dh.delete_flag, '0') != '1' AND ifnull(di.delete_flag, '0') != '1' AND DATE(dh.oper_time) >= DATE(#{beginDate}) AND DATE(dh.oper_time) <= DATE(#{endDate}) AND dh.tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY di.material_id, IFNULL(dh.shop_name, ''), DATE(dh.oper_time), dh.type, dh.sub_type ORDER BY di.material_id, IFNULL(dh.shop_name, ''), DATE(dh.oper_time)

SELECT dh.id as billId, dh.number as billNumber, DATE(dh.oper_time) as billDate, dh.type as billType, dh.sub_type as subType, IFNULL(dh.shop_name, '') as shopName, di.material_id as materialId, CASE WHEN dh.type = '入库' THEN IFNULL(di.basic_number, 0) WHEN dh.type = '出库' THEN -IFNULL(di.basic_number, 0) ELSE 0 END as quantity, di.unit_price as unitPrice FROM jsh_depot_head dh INNER JOIN jsh_depot_item di ON dh.id = di.header_id WHERE dh.status = '1' AND IFNULL(dh.delete_flag, '0') != '1' AND IFNULL(di.delete_flag, '0') != '1' AND DATE(dh.oper_time) >= DATE(#{beginDate}) AND DATE(dh.oper_time) <= DATE(#{endDate}) AND dh.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY DATE(dh.oper_time) ASC, dh.number ASC, di.id ASC

select count(distinct m.id) from jsh_material m left join jsh_material_extend me on me.material_id = m.id and ifnull(me.delete_flag,'0') != '1' and me.default_flag = '1' and me.tenant_id = #{tenantId} where ifnull(m.delete_flag,'0') != '1' and m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and (me.id is null or me.commodity_decimal is null)
{call refresh_material_period_summary(#{tenantId})}
{call update_daily_out_summary(#{materialId}, #{targetDate}, #{tenantId})}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsh_material_period_summary WHERE delete_flag = '0' AND ( current_period_stock != ROUND(current_period_stock) OR previous_period_stock != ROUND(previous_period_stock) OR current_period_out != ROUND(current_period_out) OR previous_period_out != ROUND(previous_period_out) OR current_period_in != ROUND(current_period_in) OR previous_period_in != ROUND(previous_period_in) )
mapper.update: UPDATE jsh_material_period_summary SET current_period_stock = ROUND(current_period_stock), previous_period_stock = ROUND(previous_period_stock), current_period_out = ROUND(current_period_out), previous_period_out = ROUND(previous_period_out), current_period_in = ROUND(current_period_in), previous_period_in = ROUND(previous_period_in), last_calculation_time = NOW() WHERE delete_flag = '0' AND ( current_period_stock != ROUND(current_period_stock) OR previous_period_stock != ROUND(previous_period_stock) OR current_period_out != ROUND(current_period_out) OR previous_period_out != ROUND(previous_period_out) OR current_period_in != ROUND(current_period_in) OR previous_period_in != ROUND(previous_period_in) )
mapper.select: SELECT material_id, bar_code, material_name, current_period_stock as currentPeriodStock, previous_period_stock as previousPeriodStock, current_period_out as currentPeriodOut, previous_period_out as previousPeriodOut, current_period_in as currentPeriodIn, previous_period_in as previousPeriodIn, -- 验证库存平衡：上期结存 + 本期入库 - 本期出库 应该等于本期结存 (previous_period_stock + current_period_in - current_period_out) as calculatedCurrentStock, (current_period_stock - (previous_period_stock + current_period_in - current_period_out)) as difference FROM jsh_material_period_summary WHERE delete_flag = '0' ORDER BY ABS(current_period_stock - (previous_period_stock + current_period_in - current_period_out)) DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(di.basic_number), 0) FROM jsh_depot_item di LEFT JOIN jsh_depot_head dh ON dh.id = di.header_id WHERE di.material_id = #{materialId} AND dh.type = '出库' AND dh.sub_type = '销售' AND dh.status = '1' AND IFNULL(di.delete_flag, '0') != '1' AND IFNULL(dh.delete_flag, '0') != '1' AND dh.oper_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
AND dh.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO jsh_material_period_summary ( material_id, bar_code, material_name, material_model, material_unit, current_period_stock, previous_period_stock, current_period_out, previous_period_out, current_period_in, previous_period_in ) VALUES ( #{materialId}, #{barCode}, #{materialName}, #{materialModel}, #{materialUnit}, #{currentPeriodStock}, #{previousPeriodStock}, #{currentPeriodOut}, #{previousPeriodOut}, #{currentPeriodIn}, #{previousPeriodIn} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE bar_code = VALUES(bar_code), material_name = VALUES(material_name), material_model = VALUES(material_model), material_unit = VALUES(material_unit), current_period_stock = VALUES(current_period_stock), previous_period_stock = VALUES(previous_period_stock), current_period_out = VALUES(current_period_out), previous_period_out = VALUES(previous_period_out), current_period_in = VALUES(current_period_in), previous_period_in = VALUES(previous_period_in), last_calculation_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
